findings.expected_vs_actual: Spec section 10 judge e2e suggests that adding a small half-covered src/table/probe.ts to a full copy makes npm test fail. Actual: vitest applies the glob threshold to the aggregate of all six folders, so a small probe leaves the aggregate above 90% and npm test passes; it only fails once enough uncovered lines are added (or in the minimal sandbox the locked test uses). This is vitest behaviour, consistent with the spec's 'Not doing' scope, not a defect.
findings.fix: None required for this task. If per-file enforcement is wanted later, consider a follow-up (e.g. perFile thresholds) rather than changing this task.
